text:
Kai: Heads up — onboarding zephyr-hybrid-13b (Llama-style head layout with Mistral rotary adaptor). After int4 quant we see crisp logits but summaries degrade and repetition spikes. Suspect KV-cache/token alignment or rotary scaling mismatch.
Anya: Can you paste a short repro (input -> output) and the quant config? quick checks: tokenizer version, bos/eos indices, and rotary freq scaling.
Kai: repro snippet: 
```
input = 'Summarize: The quarterly revenue...'
tokens = tok.encode(input)  # tok from convert_v1 tokenizer
out = model.generate(tokens, max_new_tokens=60, use_kv_cache=True)
```
Quant: int4 LLM.int4_avx + per-channel bias-corrected, no PTQ calibration steps, act-order = 'proj then act'.
Matt: hmm act-order sounds risky for projection layout. Also which tokenizer mapping did you use from Llama->Zephyr? We saw shifts when converters assume 0-based vs 1-based sentinel.
Kai: used converter v2 from repo, with the "preserve-ids" flag. Token id diff check shows +1 for some sentinels: first few ids look right but embedded proj mismatch on head groups.
Claire: quick suggestion: run a short forward with identical fp16 weights (no quant) but force kvcache=True and compare logits at token N between fp16 and int4 before sampling. If logits diverge early, it's structural not quant noise.
Kai: did that — fp16 vs int4 logits diverge at token 8, consistent across seeds. here's small diff: 
```
# compare logits
for i in range(12):
  print(i, np.max(abs(fp16_logits[i] - int4_logits[i])))
# values: 0, 1e-6, 2e-6, 3e-5, 0.1, 0.12, 0.13, 0.45, ...
```
Anya: large jump at token 7-8 points to KV indexing or rotary phase wrap mismatch — check if rotary_base or freq scaling was applied differently in the converter vs runtime. Also inspect head ordering: if the model has interleaved heads, int4 projection reorder can scramble K/V.
Matt: another quick probe: run same input but swap rotary scale sign or multiply phase by 0.5 — if quality flips it's rotary related. We had a similar signature with a model we called 'polaris-fusion' last quarter.
Kai: will try a ±phase multiplier and report. Also posting convert logs: converter warns about 'head_interleave: true' but runtime defaulted to false — could be the root cause.
triage-bot: New tag applied: onboarding/zephyr-hybrid. Assigned to @Anya and @Matt. Add logs to the onboarding/handoffs board. :clipboard:
Claire: once you confirm it's head_interleave mismatch we can add a small assert in conversion step (compare embedding->proj shapes) and add a smoke test: generate N tokens and compare token-level perplexities against fp16 baseline.
Kai: thanks — running the phase-sweep and toggle for head_interleave now. Will paste results in this thread in ~20m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
